Featured Project · 01

OPTIMUS — Fully Automated RNA
Extraction & Analysis Device

A fully automated RNA extraction and analysis platform that integrates RNA extraction, PCR, and CLIA modules into a single compact system. The device automates the complete workflow from sample loading to result generation — the operator loads tubes and pipette tips, and every subsequent step runs unattended.

A single-channel pipette gantry with a custom gripper lifts and uncaps up to 32 test tubes per run, while an 8-channel pipette transfers extracted RNA to the CLIA or PCR analysis zone. Integrated barcode scanning tracks every tube by serial number from load-in to result, and an inbuilt waste unit handles used tips and residual fluid without operator involvement.

Design Highlights

Integrated workflow

Combines RNA extraction, PCR, and CLIA in a single automated unit, removing hand-offs between separate machines.

Dual pipette mechanism

Single-channel gantry for precision sampling paired with an 8-channel pipette for high-throughput transfer.

Smart sample tracking

Contamination control

Efficient waste handling

Compact footprint

Space-efficient aluminum-frame structure sized for standard lab benches.

Subsystem · 02

Dual-Axis Gantry with
8-Channel Pipette

A precision two-axis motion module built to carry an 8-channel pipette across vertical (Z) and horizontal (X) travel. This gantry became the high-throughput transfer arm inside OPTIMUS, moving extracted RNA into the PCR and CLIA analysis zones — designed as a standalone, modular unit so it could be developed, tested, and upgraded independently of the rest of the machine.

Vertical motion rides on a single Igus slider driven by a Moons NEMA 17 stepper; horizontal travel is carried on four Igus sliders across the base plate for stability under repeated cycling. A V-belt drivetrain keeps both axes backlash-free and quiet in continuous operation.

Modularity & maintenance

Repeatable performance

Designed for accurate, repeatable motion suited to biomedical throughput requirements.

Subsystem · 03

Single-Channel Pipette with
Fixed Gripper

This module adapts the 8-channel dual-axis gantry into a compact single-channel pipetting station with a fixed, cam-actuated gripper. It opens individual sample tubes and performs precise single-channel pipetting into a destination vessel — reusing the same mechanical design philosophy, motors, and parts selection as the original gantry, so the two subsystems share a common maintenance and control approach inside OPTIMUS.

Vertical motion

Fixed gripper

Modularity & maintenance

Components replace or upgrade easily, with a path to integrate into future multi-channel systems.

Repeatable performance

High repeatability and accuracy tuned for biomedical applications.
